annotations.title: Check if Japan Post or the proxy can ship it

description: Check whether an item can be exported from Japan to a destination (allowed, conditional, or blocked). Use this for questions like can I ship a lithium battery, sake, whisky, or a 100 V console to the UK or US. Reasons cover lithium, alcohol, and destination lists. Not a customs clearance.

alcohol_abv.description: Alcohol by volume percent, when category is sake or whisky.

category.description: Item type. sake and whisky use the alcohol rules.

country.description: Destination ISO code or English name. Examples: US, GB, DE.

shipping_method.description: Shipping method. japan_post_sal_small_packet and japan_post_sal_parcel are accepted for compatibility but SAL is suspended (Japan Post availability chart updated 2026-10-23; Buyee lists SAL as suspended): the result has a 'suspended' shipping line with no price, listed in excludedUnknownCosts.

name: check_shippability
